title: -GT930 Pearl White

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Engineered for adaptable touring, the Scorpion EXO GT930 Pearl White is combines flip-up modular convenience with highway touring comfort across highway and urban riding. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell tips the scales at 1632g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~86 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.06 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Transformer modular with optional chin-guard removal for open-face mode.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for oval head shapes; may feel tight on round heads due to extended cheek pads.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Scorpion EXO -GT930 Pearl White: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Scorpion EXO's Modular lineup, the -GT930 Pearl White brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Scorpion EXO GT930 Pearl White represents Scorpion EXO's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~86 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) Modular helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Scorpion EXO GT930 Pearl White delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
